cases.ask: apply my notes in notes.md to the clinic prototype

files.notes.md:
# Notes on the clinic prototype (from Sam, ops lead)

1. The "New appointment" button on Today does nothing. Make it open a short form: client, time, therapist, type.
2. Rename "Customers" to "Clients" everywhere. We never say customers.
3. Settings has fake latin text under Booking policy. Write a real short policy (24h cancellation).
4. Rows in the Invoices table feel too tight.
5. When I pick "Overdue" on Invoices the table just goes blank. Say there are none.
6. Today's date in the heading should be smaller than the page title, it shouts.

cases.notes: Six clear notes on the planted faults. Note 2 says 'everywhere' itself. Note 4 is vague ('too tight') and should get a concrete reading as a default. Asking which prototype is redundant (only one).

cases.ask: the rows on the invoices table in proto-clinic are too tight, give them more room
cases.notes: One small vague note. Quick track. A good intake reads 'more room' as a number (for example 4 px to 10 px row padding) and asks one question at most: the Invoices table only, or every table.

cases.ask: make the Today screen in proto-clinic work like Linear's inbox (https://linear.app/docs/inbox) - just the flow, keep our look
cases.notes: Reference by URL, the mode (flow only) and the target screen are all in the ask. A good intake states them and asks only what the reference leaves open (for example what the detail pane shows for an appointment).

cases.ask: tighten up the spacing everywhere and use our brand font

files.CLAUDE.md:
# Northside Physio: design notes

- Brand font: Source Sans 3 (Google Fonts). Headings 600, body 400.
- Colours: blue #2457D6, ink #1D2433.
- The live prototype is proto-clinic/index.html. Anything in old/ is archived: never change it.

cases.notes: Two HTML files, but CLAUDE.md names the live one and the font. 'Tighten' is vague: a good intake gives a concrete reading (an 8 px scale, row padding) as the default. Asking which prototype or which font is redundant.

cases.ask: on the clinic prototype just rename 'Customers' to 'Clients', nothing else
cases.notes: Tiny, exact change with 'nothing else'. A good intake asks nothing or almost nothing, offers the quick track, and does not add a sweep of other notes. Planted: the heading says Customers.

cases.ask: copy the booking wizard from reference/booking-flow.html into the clinic prototype as the New appointment flow - exactly, same steps and same look
cases.notes: Local reference file, exact mode and target are given. The open point is the clash of looks (the reference uses Georgia and teal; 'same look' means copy them). A good intake names that clash in the brief rather than asking what exact means.

cases.ask: PM notes for proto-clinic below. 1) remove the descriptions under every heading everywhere 2) Today table: add a status column (arrived / waiting / in session) 3) don't touch the invoices screen at all, finance signed it off 4) Save changes on settings should show a toast instead of the grey 'Saved' 5) when done commit it and push to main
findable: screens that must not change|don't touch|invoices
cases.notes: Numbered notes in the ask. One protected screen. The person asks for a commit and a push in words: a good intake keeps it (it is their ask) and notes there is no git repo here. 'Descriptions' barely exist in the prototype: a good intake says what it found.
One vague taste note. A good intake turns 'modern' into a short concrete list as its default reading (type scale, spacing, radius, colour) and asks the person to confirm or change it.
